title: Bench Tariff Annex: Stone Setting Carat Bands and Metal Surcharges on Labour
content:
# Bench Tariff Annex: Stone Setting Carat Bands and Metal Surcharges on Labour

This annex to the bench tariff of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service carries the two level schedules that turn on the piece itself rather than on the task: the charge for setting one stone, banded by the stone's weight in carats, and the surcharge on bench labour for the metal the piece is in.

## Table A: charge for setting one stone, by carat band, USD

| Carat band | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Up to 0.50 carat | 45.00 | 58.00 | 78.00 | 105.00 | 118.00 | 175.00 |
| Above 0.50 up to 1.00 carat | 75.00 | 95.00 | 128.00 | 175.00 | 195.00 | 290.00 |
| Above 1.00 up to 2.00 carat | 125.00 | 158.00 | 215.00 | 290.00 | 325.00 | 480.00 |
| Above 2.00 carat | 195.00 | 245.00 | 335.00 | 450.00 | 505.00 | 745.00 |

The ladder is ordered and each band runs up to and including its upper weight: a stone of exactly 0.50 carat falls in the first band, a stone of 0.51 carat in the second, a stone of exactly 2.00 carat in the third and a stone of 2.01 carat in the last. The charge is per stone set.

## Table B: surcharge on bench labour by metal, percent

| Metal of the piece | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14k yellow gold | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 14k white gold | 8 | 8 | 7 | 6 | 6 | 5 |
| 18k yellow gold | 12 | 12 | 11 | 10 | 9 | 8 |
| 18k white gold | 18 | 18 | 16 | 15 | 14 | 12 |
| 14k rose gold | 6 | 6 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 4 |
| Platinum 950 | 35 | 32 | 30 | 28 | 26 | 22 |
| Sterling silver | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Palladium 500 | 25 | 24 | 22 | 20 | 18 | 16 |

The surcharge is a percentage applied to bench labour for the metal of the piece. 14k yellow gold and sterling silver carry no surcharge at any level.

## Hypothetical readings of the annex

Setting a 0.75 carat stone on a hypothetical Master Jeweler Service order is charged from the second band, 128.00 USD. Setting a 2.00 carat stone on a hypothetical Atelier White-Glove Service order is charged from the third band, 480.00 USD, because 2.00 carat is within, not above, that band. A hypothetical 100.00 USD of bench labour on a platinum 950 piece at Standard Bench Service carries a surcharge of 35 percent, 35.00 USD; the same labour on an 18k white gold piece at Atelier White-Glove Service carries 12 percent, 12.00 USD.
